message.body: Dear Customer, your credit card e-statement for September 2026 is now available. Log in to your Apex Bank mobile app or web portal to view your statement.

evidence.label: Instructions
evidence.value: Asks user to log in via official app/site (no links or attachments)

evidence.label: Apex Bank Mobile App
evidence.value: Mobile app e-statement section displays matching September statement.

consequence_text.safe: You opened your official bank app and accessed your statement securely.
consequence_text.unsafe: Reporting legitimate e-statement notifications causes unnecessary alarm.

teaching_point: Routine statement notifications directing users to official apps are safe.
